Estimate Test Sensitivity and Specificity

Source: R/hestia_functions.R
estimate_test.Rd

Specifies an observation type whose sensitivity and specificity are estimated rather than fixed, for use in make_observation_model. Compartments in positive give a positive result with probability equal to the sensitivity, and all other compartments with probability one minus the specificity. Sensitivity is constrained to exceed one minus specificity, which rules out the mirror-image solution in which the test is read the wrong way round.

Usage

estimate_test(positive, se, sp)

Arguments

positive

Character vector of compartments in which the target is present, so the test should be positive.

se

Numeric vector c(a, b) giving the Beta(a, b) prior on sensitivity.

sp

Numeric vector c(a, b) giving the Beta(a, b) prior on specificity.

Value

A list of class hestia_estimated_test.

Examples

estimate_test(positive = "I", se = c(9, 1), sp = c(19, 1))
#> $positive
#> [1] "I"
#> 
#> $se
#> [1] 9 1
#> 
#> $sp
#> [1] 19  1
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "hestia_estimated_test"
